name: comp-67
blurb: Textarea in a disabled, non-interactive state.
description: A textarea with the disabled attribute, preventing user input. Styled with reduced opacity to show disabled state.
use_when: Forms where a field needs to be shown but not editable (loading, conditional, permission-based).
avoid_when: The field is completely unnecessary (use conditional rendering instead).
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Disabled attribute prevents keyboard and mouse interaction.
